prompt.content: Compute 12 + 30. Show your work and end with #### followed by the number.
A box has 8 pencils. Three boxes are bought, then 5 pencils are given away. How many remain? End with #### followed by the number.
What is one quarter of 100? End with #### followed by the number.
A train carries 15 people. Seven leave and 9 board. How many people are on it now? End with #### followed by the number.
A box has 24 pencils. Six are removed and 5 are added. How many pencils are in the box now? End with #### followed by the number.
Mina reads 12 pages on Monday and 18 pages on Tuesday. How many pages does she read in total? End with #### followed by the number.
There are 40 birds in a park. Thirteen fly away. How many birds remain? End with #### followed by the number.
Four bags each contain 7 marbles. How many marbles are there altogether? End with #### followed by the number.
